experiment: Blind at Scale — Workstream 4: Spark cluster ground truth
labelling: multi-worker standalone cluster on a single host
dataset: zipf seed 101 (fact 10M / fact2 6M / dim 20k), generated on the pod by pod/gen_on_pod.py
headline_expected_check: PASS (per-key counts bit-identical to the local study)
t_load_note: Applied threshold T_LOAD = 200,000 = 0.02 * n_fact (PREREGISTRATION.md S.3). The operator report noted a t_load value of 20000 in an auxiliary pod output; see the reconciliation in results/spark_cluster/cluster_comparison.json and NUMBER_PROVENANCE.md: collect_results.py uses a single t_load variable for the root field, the per-pipeline fields and the verdicts, and every recorded verdict in this file is exactly the verdict that T = 200,000 produces (recomputed and asserted locally). 20000 = 0.02 * 1,000,000 is the signature of a reduced-scale (1M-row) invocation, not of this headline run (n_fact = 10,000,000 in the run manifest, written by spark_pipelines.py from fact.count()).
load_definition: GT_LOAD = max over the pipeline's tasks of Shuffle Read Metrics.Total Records Read (per-partition load; input/scan records are not verdict-bearing — file splitting is a storage artefact). For F pipelines GT_LOAD is the analytic splitmix64 load from Spark-produced per-key counts (D4). FAIL iff GT_LOAD > T_LOAD. See pod/spark_pipelines.py.
deviations: D1 murmur3 vs splitmix64; D2/D5 G/W realised as repartition shuffle (upper bound of local def); D3 J shuffle-merge, broadcast off; D4 F raw join not materialisable — analytic load from Spark counts; D6 scan splits; D7 AQE off. Full text in pod/spark_pipelines.py.
